name: Xquik
description: Search X (Twitter) posts, profiles and followers, run keyword and account monitors, and post or manage connected accounts through a 167-endpoint REST API and an OAuth-gated MCP server.

skills.name: Post Search
skills.description: Searches X posts by keyword through /api/v1/x/tweets/search and returns matching posts for monitoring and analysis.

skills.name: Profile Lookup
skills.description: Finds X accounts and checks follower relationships via the /api/v1/x/users/search and /api/v1/x/followers/check endpoints.

skills.name: Keyword Monitors
skills.description: Creates and manages standing keyword and account monitors through /api/v1/monitors so agents can track new posts over time.

skills.name: Account Actions
skills.description: Likes posts, follows accounts and sends direct messages from a connected X account using the write endpoints under /api/v1/x.

skills.name: Bulk Extractions
skills.description: Runs and retrieves larger data extraction jobs through /api/v1/extractions for datasets bigger than a single search call.

skills.name: API Execute
skills.description: Calls any documented Xquik REST endpoint from an MCP client through the server's execute tool, alongside docs, search and whoami.
